text:
marie_support: Hey team, customer reports streaming response from /v1/chat/stream truncates before final chunk — client sees incomplete JSON and finish_reason==null. Happened after they rotated API key and client reconnected. Repro steps below.

emma_devx: Uh, do we have request ids or trace ids?

marie_support: Logs attached in thread. curl they ran:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <old-token>" \
  -N "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/stream" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-3-small","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"generate json"}],"stream":true}'
```
Then they swapped token client-side and reconnected with same Resume-Offset header.

akshay_sre: Any proxy in front of them? Could be keepalive/half-close.

marie_support: They're on our hosted API via Fastly. Their network logs show a 200 stream then a short TCP RST when client rotates auth.

ryan_runtime: We recently changed token validation to do an auth check mid-stream; if auth fails on reconnect we send 401 and close without the final SSE 'event' — looks like resume logic doesn't append finish_reason. I'll pull traces.

ingress-bot: New trace created: trace_id=tr-20260317-8891, routed to runtime-12

emma_devx: Can you paste runtime log lines around trace? Even just the SSE frames would help.

ryan_runtime: runtime logs:
```
[2026-03-17T14:02:18Z] connection open ts=... id=conn-34
[2026-03-17T14:03:02Z] stream chunk id=... payload="{\"choices\":[{\"delta\":{...}}]}"
[2026-03-17T14:03:07Z] auth refresh detected for session s-123, incoming token mismatch
[2026-03-17T14:03:07Z] sending connection close (401) without finish frame
```

akshay_sre: OK that explains missing final frame. But client reports they attempted resume with header `Resume-From: 4096` and we accepted it but didn't emit final event — suspect resume handler dropped finalization state.

marie_support: Customer is asking for the exact root cause and suggested fix. They're blocked in production.

ryan_runtime: Short-term: recommend client-side workaround — close original connection fully then open new stream with new token (don't rely on resume header). We'll add to support KB.

akshay_sre: Long-term: runtime should ensure that when we close due to auth, we emit a final SSE frame with finish_reason and terminal object so clients parsing JSON don't get unterminated documents. I'll open runtime ticket.

emma_devx: Can you confirm if this interacts with our quota/billing pipeline (i.e., did we bill the final tokens)?

ryan_runtime: Billing uses committed tokens at emit time; since final chunk never emitted, we didn't charge for it. But that could lead to undercounting for customers; need product call.

marie_support: I'll notify customer and give workaround + ETA. Assigning to @ryan_runtime to create issue and @akshay_sre for mitigation plan. :thumbsup:

ryan_runtime: Created issue RW-1582 "ensure terminal SSE frame on auth-close". ETA initial fix in next patch release.

akshay_sre: I'll schedule a short rollout for ingress to guarantee we flush terminal frames even on abrupt auth closures.

marie_support: Thanks — keeping thread open until we confirm deploy and customer ack.
